# TagTrack — Phygital NFC Habit Tracker (Full Context)

> Track your habits by touching real objects. Tap NFC or scan QR. Logged in 2 seconds.

TagTrack is a phygital (physical + digital) habit tracker for iOS.
It turns everyday objects into habit buttons using NFC tags and QR codes.
No need to open an app — just tap a sticker on your water bottle, gym bag, or pill box.

## Why TagTrack

- Under 2 seconds to log any habit
- No app opening required — NFC works from lock screen
- Real-world reminders — tags on physical objects
- Gamification — XP, badges, levels, streaks
- 100% offline — all data stays on device + iCloud
- Privacy-first — no data collection, no ads

## Core Features

- **NFC Instant Tap**: Program any NFC tag to log a habit instantly, even from lock screen
- **QR Code Support**: Generate and print QR codes for free from the app
- **iOS Widgets**: One-tap logging directly from your iPhone home screen
- **Statistics & Streaks**: XP system, levels (Beginner → Legend → Grandmaster), contribution heatmaps, weekly/monthly/yearly views
- **Habit Library**: Hundreds of presets (water, vitamins, exercise, reading, meditation…) + fully custom habits
- **Gamification**: Badges, daily/weekly streaks, fire counters, level progression
- **Themes & Skins**: Customizable app appearance with premium themes

## How It Works

1. **Pick your habit** — Select from hundreds of presets or create your own custom tracking goal
2. **Link a Tag or QR** — Hold your phone near an NFC sticker or generate a QR code to link your habit
3. **Tap to Log** — Whenever you complete the habit, just tap the sticker. Done in under 2 seconds!

## Use Cases

- **Water bottle** → track hydration (e.g., "Water 2/8" glasses)
- **Vitamin pill box** → never forget your daily dose
- **Gym bag** → log workout sessions automatically
- **Desk** → start study or focus sessions
- **Bathroom mirror** → skincare routine tracking
- **Coffee machine** → monitor caffeine intake
- **Medicine cabinet** → medication adherence

## Platform & Pricing

- **Platform**: iOS (iPhone) — Available on the App Store
- **Download**: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6754224455
- **Free tier**: Up to 3 habits with core NFC/QR tracking
- **Pro**: €9.99/year — unlimited habits, advanced stats, premium themes, all widgets

## Technical Stack

- **App**: Swift, SwiftUI, Core NFC, SwiftData, WidgetKit, StoreKit 2
- **Website**: Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Developer**: Xavier Larrodé
- **Privacy**: No analytics on user habits. No data sold. Local storage + iCloud sync only.
